questions.question_text: Explain why tin roofs blow off houses during high-speed windstorms.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: High-speed wind over the roof drops air pressure above it. Higher stationary atmospheric pressure inside the house exerts an upward force lifting the roof.

questions.question_text: Analyze why rubber suckers stick firmly to smooth glass surfaces when pressed.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Pressing the rubber cup squeezes out trapped air beneath it, creating a low-pressure void. High external atmospheric pressure presses firmly against the outer surface, holding it tightly to the glass.

questions.question_text: Describe the complete atmospheric process driving cyclone formation over warm tropical oceans.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: 1. Solar heat warms tropical ocean surface water above 27 deg C. 2. Warm humid air rises rapidly, leaving an intense low-pressure zone at the ocean surface. 3. Cooler high-pressure air from surrounding areas rushes inward. 4. Earth's rotation (Coriolis effect) causes inflowing air currents to spiral rapidly. 5. Water vapor condenses into clouds, releasing latent heat that fuels high-speed winds and thunderstorm spiraling.

questions.question_text: Explain the principle of 6.2 Atmospheric Pressure and Meteorological Storm Dynamics and state its scientific significance.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Atmospheric air column weight exerts atmospheric pressure (~100 kPa at sea level). High-speed wind creation drops local air pressure, driving wind movement from high to low pressure zones. Rising warm humid air forms tropical cyclones. [Meteorology Note: Cyclone Eye] The central eye of a cyclone is a calm, low-pressure region surrounded by high-speed rotating wind walls.

questions.question_text: Explain the principle of 6.1 Pressure Mechanics in Solids and Fluids and state its scientific significance.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Pressure is perpendicular force per unit contact area (P = F/A). Smaller contact area concentrates force, producing higher pressure. Liquid pressure increases proportionally with depth and acts equally in all directions at equal depth. [Think like a scientist: Sharp Knife vs Dull Knife] A sharp edge has a tiny contact area, generating huge pressure for small applied force to cut easily.

[Meteorology Note: Cyclone Eye] The central eye of a cyclone is a calm, low-pressure region surrounded by high-speed rotating wind walls.

questions.question_text:
Scenario: A boy stands vertically on loose sand, sinking 10 cm. When he lies down horizontally on the same sand, he sinks only 1 cm.
Question: Analyze the situation and solve.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Weight (force) is constant. Standing concentrates weight over small foot area, producing high pressure. Lying down spreads weight over body area, producing low pressure.
